messages.subject: R1033 report completed
messages.body: I wrote the source-grounded R1033 decision-support report auditing the immutable API snapshot, measured evidence, primary framework references, and score/GEMM layout. The prior R589 input-stride blocker is resolved by flattening contiguous query heads; the existing oneMKL FP16/BF16 inputs with FP32 output fit, while both current native16 output APIs round too early, and GPU provider/quality remain unqualified. Main owns the minimal same-contract checks and any implementation decision; no product code or tests were changed.
